verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents schema-based structured extraction into JSON, but nothing in the evidence mentions per-field confidence scores, calibration, or a review queue for low-confidence fields. The job APIs' ability to 'inspect any files that failed during processing' covers processing failures, not confidence-based human review, so it is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields
